kind: literature research agent and retrieval library

runtime.execution: Async Aviary/LDP/custom tool-selector loop over document/index/session state; separate answer/summary/embedding provider calls.
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes model/embedding/literature APIs; owns local document index and transient question/session evidence, no owned scientific execution kernel.

summary: A literature retrieval/evidence/answer agent whose callable vocabulary is research operations rather than arbitrary coding or shell.

inspection.scope: agent selection/loop/timeout, tool construction, evidence mutation/reset, persistent index recovery and selected assertions
inspection.limits: Aviary/LDP/LiteLLM inner provider transports remain dependencies; inspected loop and domain operations do not establish general coding-agent features. Tests not run.

actions.name: agent_query / run_agent
actions.input: Query, Docs, Settings, agent type/custom runner and callbacks.
actions.lifecycle: Async bounded rollout; timeout can trigger answer fallback with TRUNCATED status.
actions.authority: Caller configures models and tool vocabulary.

actions.name: paper_search
actions.output: Search result/status; matching document texts enter Docs.
actions.lifecycle: Repeated query/year increments search offset; concurrency-safe discovery metadata.
actions.authority: Configured local corpus/search clients, not unrestricted filesystem search.

actions.name: gather_evidence / gen_answer
actions.input: Specific question for evidence; current session for answer.
actions.output: Scored cited contexts and synthesized answer in PQASession.
actions.lifecycle: Evidence summaries are bounded parallel calls; shared question swapped/restored; answer models separate.
actions.authority: Configured summary/answer/embedding providers; authored synthesis is not source truth.

actions.name: reset / complete
actions.input: Reset no arguments; complete has_successful_answer boolean.
actions.output: Cleared current contexts; terminal Certain/Unsure status and latest answer.
actions.lifecycle: Reset does not discard corpus; complete terminates using existing answer.
actions.authority: Model-declared certainty; no independent verification gate.

actions.name: get_directory_index / indexed per-file processing
actions.output: Persisted index/document identities and marked failures.
actions.lifecycle: Resumable per-file build; concurrent process locking is not supplied.
actions.authority: Operator supplied corpus/index serialization; historical material remains data.

filesystem.detail: Reads/indexes operator-supplied paper files and writes local persistent index objects; the model tool vocabulary is literature search/evidence/answer, not generic file editing.

processes.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected agent selection/loop/timeout, tool construction, evidence mutation/reset, persistent index recovery and selected assertions; no universal absence claim.

code_actions.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected agent selection/loop/timeout, tool construction, evidence mutation/reset, persistent index recovery and selected assertions; no universal absence claim.

persistent_kernel.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected agent selection/loop/timeout, tool construction, evidence mutation/reset, persistent index recovery and selected assertions; no universal absence claim.

standing_database.detail: Persistent searchable corpus/index and session citation contexts support standing literature memory. This is not a generic standing SQL database callable by the model.

workflow_programming.detail: Operator can compose custom runner/tool selector, configured tools/models and per-action/environment callbacks. Domain reset/search/gather/generate sequence is programmable; no general live workflow scheduler is established.

multi_model.detail: Agent selection, answer, evidence-summary and embedding model roles are configured separately. These are pipeline roles, not live independent peers.

live_collaboration.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected agent selection/loop/timeout, tool construction, evidence mutation/reset, persistent index recovery and selected assertions; no universal absence claim.

concurrent_work.detail: Paper search metadata permits concurrency and evidence snippets are summarized with a bounded parallel request limit. gather_evidence mutates shared question and cannot run concurrently with itself; index lacks cross-process file locks.

steering_interrupt.detail: Overall runner timeout and max timestep force truncated status and may issue one answer-generation fallback. No operator steer/pause handle is established in inspected runner.

turn_redefinition.detail: Settings choose fake/Aviary/LDP or custom selector plus callbacks; this is per-run composition, not hot turn-program replacement.

compaction.detail: Evidence retrieval reduces corpus to bounded summarized matches. This is domain retrieval compression, not archived conversational context compaction.

context_repair.detail: Model reset discards unsuitable current evidence, then can search/gather afresh; original indexed documents remain. It does not reconstruct lost/corrupted full conversation.

original_audit.detail: Session stores token counts/tool-name batches, answer/citation contexts and callback opportunities; this is not every original request/result or execution audit.

audit_query.detail: Tool-history name lookup and evidence/corpus retrieval expose selected research records, not a general complete audit query.

hot_change.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected agent selection/loop/timeout, tool construction, evidence mutation/reset, persistent index recovery and selected assertions; no universal absence claim.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Index construction resumes saved per-file marks after crash; active agent/provider/turn state and executable rebuild continuity are outside that mechanism.

remote_services.detail: Search/index clients and distinct model/embedding calls are consumed through configured tools/Docs pipeline; no remote shell/kernel/service governance is implied.

self_improvement.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected agent selection/loop/timeout, tool construction, evidence mutation/reset, persistent index recovery and selected assertions; no universal absence claim.

complaints.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected agent selection/loop/timeout, tool construction, evidence mutation/reset, persistent index recovery and selected assertions; no universal absence claim.

authority.detail: Configured tool set defines model action ceiling; model must call tools and reports its own answer sufficiency. No generic command-approval gate is present in traced domain dispatcher; provider/library policies remain external.

evaluation.detail: Model has_successful_answer is a declared sufficiency signal; truncation/timeout may still produce an answer. Inspected agent tests assert nonempty answer/evidence/cost, not independent semantic/scientific truth.

time_order.detail: Loop accumulates action then observations; search pagination and index records maintain local progress. No durable complete causal event stream is established.

evidence.claim: run_agent chooses fake/Aviary/LDP runner; index is built once; timeout/truncation may force answer generation while retaining truncated/fail status.
ToolSelectorLedger accumulates observations/actions, retries malformed model messages five times, awaits environment step and stops on complete or max timestep.
Settings constructs named tools with concurrency metadata and separate answer/summary/embedding models; complete is ordered last in discovery.
Session action recording counts tokens and only native tool names in tool_history; relevant contexts are score filtered.
paper_search accepts query/year filters, permits search concurrency and tracks pagination by repeated query/year pair.
gather_evidence temporarily replaces session question and restores it finally; this mutability prevents parallel calls of itself.
Evidence retrieval obtains bounded matches and parallel LLM summaries under session identity using explicit concurrency limit.
gen_answer calls Docs.aquery with current session plus distinct model roles and callbacks.
reset clears current contexts; complete records model-reported successful-answer boolean and installs no-answer phrase if absent.
Reset creates fresh query session; index building is excluded because it lacks file locks; ordinary prose is rejected as progress.
Per-file index build uses semaphore and records failed documents/save state for resumable construction.

tests.focus: Index crash resume and agent answer/accounting plumbing
tests.oracle: Inspected lines 183–234 inject a crash after known file count, reopen index and assert all files indexed with fewer reparses than full rebuild. Lines 350–393 assert nonempty answer/context, question equality, tokens/cost and formatting under a debug prompt demanding tool order. This verifies mechanics, not correctness of the answer; provider fixtures/cassettes are not live validation. Not run.

strengths: Explicit separation of retrieval, evidence summary, answer and termination.
Persistent corpus offers source-grounded recall and recoverable per-file indexing.
limits: Research tool vocabulary is not general scientific/coding execution.
Model-declared answer sufficiency and nonempty-output tests are weak semantic oracles.
Shared evidence mutation and unlocked index builds constrain concurrency.
arconaut_questions: How should retrieved/summarized evidence remain distinct from original source bytes in managed context?
Can specialist role/model decomposition expose clear source authority and independent oracles?
